title: Rolls
confidence: confirmed names and inputs / the dice model does not fit the v1 shape
notes: The sheet has exactly four rolls, hardwired into two layouts.

Every dice count is 0 and that is not a placeholder oversight: the sheet does not give a roll a fixed dice pool. It feeds the input value through the [20, 12, 6] dice ladder (Calculator!I16:L16) and the pool falls out — input 10 becomes 0D20 + 0D12 + 1D6 + 4. The v1 CombatSkill shape cannot express that; TICKET-ROLL-03/04 build the ladder and TICKET-ROLL-05/06 replace this fragment with real roll definitions.

evasion and endure carry an unexplained term (+7 and +4 over the raw stat). bonusFormula holds the raw stat only, so the numbers are honestly short rather than fitted with a constant nobody can source.
